description: brig·id: the one Renovate preset, extended by every repository with
Renovate opens pull requests and never merges them. A repository gets at most, on a
Monday, one pull request for everything from outside the project; a lock file refresh a
month; a security fix at once. A major version waits on the Dependency Dashboard until
its box is ticked. The project's own repositories are not Renovate's to move.

schedule: before 7am on the first day of the month

description: An update from outside the project is a build(deps) commit: it ships with the next
release of a server and is no reason for one (`brigid release` counts feat, fix, perf and
revert). config:recommended would make a runtime dependency fix(deps). A security fix is

packageRules.description: Everything from outside the project but a major: ONE pull request a week per repository.
A major version is a decision: one pull request each, opened from the Dependency Dashboard.

description: The project's own repositories are left alone. A server follows crypto and the core at a
commit of their main (branch = "main" in Cargo.toml, the commit in Cargo.lock) and the
interface at a commit of its main (APP_REF in its ci.yml): the pull request that needs a
newer commit moves it, and the monthly lock file refresh brings the rest. The reusable
workflows of brig-id/.github are called at @main: without this rule,
helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests would pin that to a commit and open a pull request in every
repository each time a workflow changes.
